name: token-weather-usage
description: One line above the prompt: context tokens with their weather, a bar per recent prompt, your 5-hour and 7-day limits against the time elapsed, the prompt cache with its time left, the session cost, and the subagents running. Labels in English or French. After Token Weather (Anthropic, Apache-2.0) and the ideas of usage-meter (HolyGrail) and prompt-cache-control (Daniel San). This copy (upstream augiefra/claude-mods 701aa6f, Apache-2.0): in the desktop app the pills wrap to the band's width instead of being cut off; a two-press Handoff button writes a handoff note to ~/.claude/handoffs, compacts, then ends the session; the agents pill opens /flightdeck.

language.title: Language
language.description: Labels in English (en) or French (fr), or auto: follows LC_ALL, LC_MESSAGES or LANG, and falls back to English.

context.title: Context pill
context.description: Show the context pill: the weather icon, the context in tokens, the recent-turns chart and the last turn's change
